comment: Each one-line notice that a rule can post, and whether it lands in the notice log of the menu (D-221, D-983). The log field is required, so the writer marks each notice. The line of a notice lives in the string table under the id of the notice (G-7). PR-62 holds two fixture notices, one of each kind, which the debug console posts (D-989). The chest, the door, the task, and the key item of later PRs add their own notices here.
